information: Please note once you register in WCA site for the Cubing Returns Bengaluru 2022, your name will be in waiting list and once your payment is done then your name will appear in competitors list in 1-2 days. All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except New comers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to either judge, scramble, etc for the group/event. The duties will be assigned by a software and finalised by the organising team in consultation with the delegates. This information will be provided to all participants at least 2 days before the event. We will also ensure that your volunteering will not affect your main events and participation. **Important Note: Since accepting the registrations is manually done, please wait for 2 days before your registration is accepted, after paying the registration fees ** COVID-19 Specific Information: * Wearing masks, Sanitizing hands frequently and following all local goverment orders is mandatory while attending the competition.
